apps.allow_client_commands_desc: Whether to execute client prepare commands when running this app.
apps.app_name_desc: Application Name, as shown on Moonlight
apps.applications_desc: Applications are refreshed when a session is terminated.
apps.applications_reorder_desc: Drag and drop apps to reorder the apps. Any changes made will terminate the current running app.
apps.applications_tips:
Tip: You can also right click the launch app button to copy the launch link, and send it to your friends. They need to use Artemis and have already paired with you.
You can also double click the app name to export the app entry to a file, to add them to your favorite emulator frontends.
apps.auto_detach: Continue streaming if the application exits quickly
apps.auto_detach_desc: This will attempt to automatically detect launcher-type apps that close quickly after launching another program or instance of themselves. When a launcher-type app is detected, it is treated as a detached app.
apps.close_warning: Are you sure to terminate the current running app?
apps.cmd_desc: The main application to start. If blank, no application will be started.
apps.cmd_note: If the path to the command executable contains spaces, you must enclose it in quotes.
apps.cmd_prep_desc: A list of commands to be run before/after this application. If any of the prep-commands fail, starting the application is aborted.
apps.cmd_state_desc:
A list of commands to be run when resuming(first client connects when no clients are connected) or pausing(all clients disconnect) this application.
Do commands for resume and Undo command for pause.
Please make sure to clean up any side effects of the commands in the preparation undo commands.
Please note that pause command will not be executed when the session terminates.
apps.detached_cmds_desc: A list of commands to be run in the background.
apps.detached_cmds_note: If the path to the command executable contains spaces, you must enclose it in quotes.
apps.env_client_audio_config: The Audio Configuration requested by the client (2.0/5.1/7.1)
apps.env_client_enable_sops: The client has requested the option to optimize the game for optimal streaming (true/false)
apps.env_client_fps: The FPS requested by the client (float)
apps.env_client_gcmap: The requested gamepad mask, in a bitset/bitfield format (int)
apps.env_client_hdr: HDR is enabled by the client (true/false)
apps.env_client_height: The Height requested by the client (int)
apps.env_client_host_audio: The client has requested host audio (true/false)
apps.env_client_width: The Width requested by the client (int)
apps.env_client_uuid: UUID of the client starting the stream (string)
apps.env_client_name: Name of the client starting the stream (string)
apps.env_sunshine_compatibility: Environment variables starting with "SUNSHINE_" are deprecated but still kept for compatibility with Sunshine related tools. The SUNSHINE_CLIENT_FPS variable is modified to FLOAT for fractional refresh rate support(especially for Special-K), if your script/tool can't take floating number input, go to Advanced tab to enable "ENVVAR compatibility mode". APOLLO_CLIENT_FPS is always FLOAT type.
apps.env_vars_desc: All commands get these environment variables by default:
apps.exit_timeout_desc: Number of seconds to wait for all app processes to gracefully exit when requested to quit. If unset, the default is to wait up to 5 seconds. If set to zero or a negative value, the app will be immediately terminated.
apps.global_prep_desc: Enable/Disable the execution of Global Prep Commands for this application.
apps.global_state_desc: Enable/Disable the execution of Global Resume/Pause Commands for this application.
apps.image_desc: Application icon/picture/image path that will be sent to client. Image must be a PNG file. If not set, Norishine will send default box image.
apps.launch_local_client: Do you want to launch the app from local client on this device?
apps.launch_warning: Are you sure you want to launch this app? This will terminate the currently running app.
apps.name: Name
apps.output_desc: The file where the output of the command is stored, if it is not specified, the output is ignored
apps.per_client_app_identity_desc: Separate the app's identity per-client. Useful when you want different virtual display configurations on this specific app for different clients
apps.resolution_scale_factor_desc: Scale the client requested resolution based on this factor. e.g. 2000x1000 with a factor of 120% will become 2400x1200. Overrides client requested factor when the number isn't 100%. This option won't affect client requested streaming resolution.
apps.run_as_desc: This can be necessary for some applications that require administrator permissions to run properly. Might cause URL schemes to fail.
apps.terminate_on_pause_desc: Terminate the app when all clients are disconnected.
apps.use_app_identity_desc: Use the app's own identity while creating virtual displays instead of client's. This is useful when you want display configuration for each APP separately.
apps.virtual_display_desc: Always create a virtual display when starting this app, overriding client request. Please make sure the SudoVDA driver is installed and enabled.
apps.virtual_display_primary_desc: Automatically set the virtual display as primary display when the app starts. Virtual display will always be set to primary when client requests to use virtual display. (Recommended to keep on) [Broken on Windows 11 24H2]
apps.wait_all: Continue streaming until all app processes exit
apps.wait_all_desc: This will continue streaming until all processes started by the app have terminated. When unchecked, streaming will stop when the initial app process exits, even if other app processes are still running.
apps.working_dir_desc: The working directory that should be passed to the process. For example, some applications use the working directory to search for configuration files. If not set, Norishine will default to the parent directory of the command

config.adapter_name_desc_linux_1: Manually specify a GPU to use for capture.
config.adapter_name_desc_linux_2: to find all devices capable of VAAPI
config.adapter_name_desc_linux_3: Replace ``renderD129`` with the device from above to lists the name and capabilities of the device. To be supported by Norishine, it needs to have at the very minimum:
config.always_send_scancodes_desc: Helps games that ignore keyboard input. Turn off if keys come out wrong with a non-US keyboard layout.
config.amd_coder_desc: Allows you to select the entropy encoding to prioritize quality or encoding speed. H.264 only.
config.amd_enforce_hrd_desc: Fewer bitrate spikes, but can reduce quality on some cards.
config.amd_quality_desc: This controls the balance between encoding speed and quality.
config.amd_rc_desc: How the encoder keeps to the bitrate.
config.amd_usage_desc: The base settings the options below adjust. Ultra low latency suits game streaming.
config.amd_vbaq_desc: Spends more data on smooth areas, where artifacts show most.
config.apply_note: Click 'Apply' to restart Norishine and apply changes. This will terminate any running sessions.
config.audio_sink_desc_linux: The name of the audio sink used for Audio Loopback. If you do not specify this variable, pulseaudio will select the default monitor device. You can find the name of the audio sink using either command:
config.audio_sink_desc_macos: The name of the audio sink used for Audio Loopback. Norishine can only access microphones on macOS due to system limitations. To stream system audio using Soundflower or BlackHole.
config.auto_capture_sink: Follow changes to the default audio device
config.auto_capture_sink_desc: If you change the default sound device during a stream, stream the new one.
config.av1_mode_desc: AV1 looks better than HEVC at the same bitrate, but only newer graphics cards and devices support it.
config.back_button_timeout: Hold Back for the Guide button
config.back_button_timeout_desc: Holding Back/Select this long presses Guide/PS, for controllers without that button.
config.capture_desc: Automatic uses the first one that works. Try the other one if the stream is black or stutters.
config.cert_desc: Used for this page and for pairing. Changing it means every device has to pair again.
config.channels_desc_1: Norishine can allow a single streaming session to be shared with multiple clients simultaneously.
config.channels_desc_2: Some hardware encoders may have limitations that reduce performance with multiple streams.
config.coder_cabac: cabac -- context adaptive binary arithmetic coding - higher quality
config.coder_cavlc: cavlc -- context adaptive variable-length coding - faster decode
config.controller_desc: For all devices. You can also turn input on or off per device on the Devices page.
config.credentials_file_desc: Keep the web UI username and password in a file of your choice instead of the state folder.
config.dd_configuration_option: Prepare the monitor when a stream starts
config.dd_config_ensure_only_display: Deactivate other displays and activate only the specified display
config.dd_config_ensure_primary: Activate the display automatically and make it a primary display
config.dd_config_revert_delay: Wait before putting the monitor back
config.dd_config_revert_delay_desc: After a stream ends, wait this long before undoing the changes, so switching apps doesn't flicker.
config.dd_config_revert_on_disconnect: Put the monitor back when every device disconnects
config.dd_config_revert_on_disconnect_desc: Normally the changes are undone when the app closes. Turn on to undo them when the last device disconnects, even if the app keeps running.
config.dd_config_verify_only: Verify that the display is enabled
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_1: Specify remapping entries to change the requested resolution and/or refresh rate to other values.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_2: The list is iterated from top to bottom and the first match is used.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_3: "Requested" fields can be left empty to match any requested value.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_4_final_values_mi: At least one "Final" field must be specified. The unspecified resolution or refresh rate will not be changed.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_4_final_values_no: "Final" field must be specified and cannot be empty.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_5_sops_mixed_only: "Optimize game settings" option must be enabled in the Moonlight client, otherwise entries with any resolution fields specified are skipped.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc_5_sops_resolution: "Optimize game settings" option must be enabled in the Moonlight client, otherwise the mapping is skipped.
config.dd_refresh_rate_option_manual_desc: Enter the refresh rate to be used
config.dd_resolution_option_manual_desc: Enter the resolution to be used
config.dd_resolution_option_ogs_desc: "Optimize game settings" option must be enabled on the Moonlight client for this to work.
config.dd_resolution_option_vdisplay_desc: Not recommended to use this option on usual circumstances. Please use native Windows settings to change display configurations. When using virtual display, only built-in resolution and client requested resolution/refresh rate will work.
config.dd_resolution_option_multi_instance_desc: When using multiple instance of Norishine, make sure you have disabled this option in all instances, or it'll end up messing things up. It's still recommended to disable this part if you don't want your physical monitor's resolution to change or you only stream with virtual display.
config.double_refreshrate: Run the virtual display at double refresh rate
config.double_refreshrate_desc: Can reduce stutter on some PCs. The stream's frame rate doesn't change.
config.ds4_back_as_touchpad_click_desc: When a PlayStation controller is used, the Back/Select button presses the touchpad.
config.enable_discovery_desc: Turn off to hide the PC on the network. Devices then need its IP address.
config.enable_input_only_mode_desc: Adds an app that sends input to the PC without picture or sound, for example to use your phone as a keyboard while streaming to the TV.
config.enable_pairing_desc: Turn off once your devices are paired, so nobody else can pair. Paired devices keep working.
config.encoder_desc: Automatic picks the best one. A graphics card you choose here must be the one your monitor is connected to.
config.envvar_compatibility_mode_desc: Gives scripts SUNSHINE_CLIENT_FPS as a whole number (60) instead of the exact rate. For older scripts written for Sunshine.
config.external_ip_desc: For streaming over the internet. Leave empty to detect it.
config.fallback_mode_desc: Used when an app is started from this page, or a device doesn't send a resolution. For example 1920x1080x60.
config.fec_percentage_desc: Extra data sent to repair lost packets. Raise it on unreliable Wi-Fi; it uses more bandwidth.
config.client_tuning_desc: A device's Performance or Quality tuning picks a faster or a higher-quality encoder preset for its own stream. Balanced, and devices without tuning, use the encoder settings here.
config.adaptive_bitrate_desc: During each stream, lower the bitrate and raise error correction when the network can't keep up, then return to the device's bitrate when it can. The device's bitrate is never exceeded.
config.adaptive_min_bitrate_desc: The bitrate is never lowered below this, or below the device's own bitrate if that is lower.
config.adaptive_max_fec_desc: Error correction is raised up to this when packets are lost, and returns to the error correction setting when the network is clean again.
config.file_apps_desc: Where the app list is saved.
config.file_state_desc: Where the host's state used to be kept in one file (Apollo's sunshine_state.json). Norishine keeps it in a "state" folder next to this path: the host's ID, paired devices and the web UI account. An existing file is moved there on start and kept as a .v0.bak copy.
config.forward_rumble_desc: Send game vibration to the device's controller.
config.gamepad_desc: Automatic uses a PlayStation controller when yours has motion sensors or a touchpad, and an Xbox controller otherwise.
config.global_prep_cmd: Commands when any app starts and stops
config.global_prep_cmd_desc: "Do" runs before an app starts, "Undo" after it closes. If a "Do" command fails, the app doesn't start.
config.global_state_cmd: Commands when devices join and leave
config.global_state_cmd_desc: "Do" runs when the first device connects, "Undo" when the last one leaves. "Undo" doesn't run when the app closes; put that cleanup in the commands above.
config.headless_mode_desc: Each stream gets its own screen that matches the device's resolution and refresh rate, and your monitors are left alone. Turn off to stream one of your monitors instead. A virtual display is also used when no monitor is connected, or when an app or device asks for one.
config.hevc_mode_desc: HEVC looks better than H.264 at the same bitrate. Automatic offers it when the graphics card supports it.
config.hide_tray_controls: Hide Stop and Restart in the tray menu
config.hide_tray_controls_desc: Useful when other people use this PC.
config.high_resolution_scrolling_desc: Pass fine scrolling from touchpads and smooth wheels. Turn off if old programs scroll too fast.
config.ignore_encoder_probe_failure: Start even if no encoder is found
config.ignore_encoder_probe_failure_desc: Lets the host start when its encoder check fails, for example with no monitor connected. Streams may then fail.
config.install_steam_audio_drivers_desc: If Steam is installed, adds Steam Streaming Speakers so 5.1 and 7.1 sound work and the PC can stay silent while streaming.
config.isolated_virtual_display_option: Keep the mouse on the virtual display
config.isolated_virtual_display_option_desc: Places the virtual display to the right of all your monitors so the mouse can't wander onto them.
config.keep_sink_default: Keep it as the default during streams
config.keep_sink_default_desc: Stops Windows switching the sound back to your speakers mid-stream.
config.key_repeat_delay_desc: How long a key is held before it starts repeating.
config.key_repeat_frequency_desc: Repeats per second while a key is held.
config.key_rightalt_to_key_win: Right Alt acts as the Windows key
config.key_rightalt_to_key_win_desc: For devices that can't send the Windows key.
config.keyboard_desc: For all devices. You can also turn input on or off per device on the Devices page.
config.lan_encryption_mode_desc: Encryption costs a little performance on slow devices.
config.legacy_ordering: Keep app order in older Moonlight versions
config.legacy_ordering_desc: Adds hidden characters to app names so older clients keep your order. Can garble names in some clients or scripts. Each device can also turn it off on the Devices page.
config.limit_framerate: Capture at the stream's frame rate
config.limit_framerate_desc: Don't capture faster than the device asked for. Turning it off can cause lag on some devices.
config.locale_desc: Language of this page and the tray menu.
config.min_log_level_desc: How much the host writes to its log (see Troubleshooting). Only raise it when you're collecting logs for a problem.
config.max_bitrate_desc: Caps the stream's bitrate, whatever the device asks for. Usually best left at No limit; set the bitrate in Moonlight instead.
config.minimum_fps_target_desc: When nothing on screen changes, keep sending at least this many frames per second. Automatic suits most devices.
config.min_threads_desc: How many CPU threads the CPU encoder uses at least. Raise it if CPU encoding can't keep up.
config.motion_as_ds4: Use a PlayStation controller for controllers with motion sensors
config.mouse_desc: For all devices. You can also turn input on or off per device on the Devices page.
config.native_pen_touch_desc: Send pen and touch as real pen and touch input. Turn off for old programs that don't understand it; touch then moves the mouse.
config.notify_pre_releases_desc: Also notify you when a test version is released, not only full releases.
config.nvenc_h264_cavlc: Simpler H.264 for very old devices (CAVLC)
config.nvenc_h264_cavlc_desc: Needs about 10% more bitrate for the same quality.
config.nvenc_intra_refresh_desc: Some clients, such as the Xbox app, need this to show the picture correctly.
config.nvenc_latency_over_power: Keep the GPU at full speed while streaming
config.nvenc_opengl_vulkan_on_dxgi: Capture OpenGL and Vulkan games at full frame rate
config.nvenc_opengl_vulkan_on_dxgi_desc: Changes an NVIDIA driver setting while Norishine runs, and undoes it when it exits.
config.nvenc_preset_desc: Slower settings look better at the same bitrate but add latency. Raising the bitrate in Moonlight usually helps more.
config.nvenc_realtime_hags_desc: Turn off if the stream freezes when the GPU is nearly out of memory and hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling is on.
config.nvenc_spatial_aq: Better flat areas at low bitrate (Spatial AQ)
config.nvenc_spatial_aq_desc: Spends more data on flat areas such as skies. Helps at low bitrates.
config.nvenc_twopass_desc: A quick first pass keeps the stream to its bitrate and avoids packet loss.
config.nvenc_vbv_increase_desc: Lets single frames go over the average size by this much, which improves fast motion. Too high can cause packet loss. 0 keeps it strict.
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_desc: Only change this if you know you need to reach this page from outside your home.
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_lan: This PC and your home network
config.ping_timeout: End the stream after no contact for
config.ping_timeout_desc: End a stream when the device hasn't been heard from for this long.
config.pkey_desc: Used for this page and for pairing. Changing it means every device has to pair again.
config.port_desc: The host uses this port and a few next to it; this page is on the port + 1. Devices that already know this PC will need it re-added.
config.port_http_port_note: Use this port to connect with Moonlight.
config.port_warning: Exposing the Web UI to the internet is a security risk! Proceed at your own risk!
config.qp_desc: Only for encoders that can't keep to a bitrate (rare). Lower values look better and use more data.
config.qsv_slow_hevc: Allow HEVC on older Intel graphics
config.qsv_slow_hevc_desc: Uses more GPU and can stutter.
config.restart_note: Norishine is restarting to apply changes.
config.server_cmd_desc: Shown in Moonlight's menu during a stream. A device also needs "Run server commands" on the Devices page.
config.stream_audio_desc: Turn off to stream the picture only, for example when using the device as an extra monitor.
config.sunshine_name_desc: The name your devices show for this PC. Leave empty to use the PC's name.
config.sw_preset_desc: Slower presets look better but need much more CPU.
config.sw_tune_desc: Zero latency is right for game streaming.
config.system_tray: Show icon in the system tray
config.system_tray_desc: Shows Norishine next to the clock, with shortcuts to this page.
config.touchpad_as_ds4: Use a PlayStation controller for controllers with a touchpad
config.upnp: Open ports on the router automatically (UPnP)
config.upnp_desc: Needed to stream over the internet, unless you forward the ports yourself. The router must allow UPnP.
config.vaapi_strict_rc_buffer_desc: Fixes stutter with some AMD graphics on Linux.
config.virtual_sink: Audio device while the PC is silent
config.virtual_sink_desc: Used when the PC's speakers are muted for the stream. Leave empty for Steam Streaming Speakers.
config.wan_encryption_mode_desc: Encryption costs a little performance on slow devices.
config.ds5_inputtino_randomize_mac_desc: Give each emulated DualSense controller a random MAC address. Turn this off if games should recognise the same controller every session.
config.keybindings_desc: Turn a key the client sends into another key on the host. By default the generic Shift, Ctrl and Alt keys become their left-hand versions, which some games need.
config.audio_sink_desc: Used when the device keeps sound playing on this PC, by name or device ID. Leave empty for the default device.
config.adapter_name_desc: Which graphics card captures and encodes, by name (for example "Radeon RX 580 Series"). Leave empty unless the PC has more than one and the wrong one is used.
config.output_name_desc: Used when not streaming to a virtual display. Automatic uses the main display.
config.dd_configuration_option_desc: Changes are undone when the stream ends. If you run more than one host on this PC, set this to "Don't change anything" in all of them.
config.dd_resolution_option_desc: Switch the monitor to the device's resolution during the stream. Needs "Optimize game settings" on in Moonlight.
config.dd_refresh_rate_option_desc: Switch the monitor to the device's frame rate during the stream.
config.dd_hdr_option_desc: Turn HDR on or off on the monitor to match the device.
config.dd_wa_hdr_toggle_delay_desc: If HDR looks washed out on a virtual display, turn HDR off and on again when a stream starts, with this pause in between. About 500 ms usually works. Makes streams start a little slower.
config.dd_mode_remapping_desc: Replace the resolution or refresh rate a client asks for with other values. Entries are checked from top to bottom and the first match is used. Leave a "Requested" field empty to match any value. Entries with a resolution only work when "Optimize game settings" is on in Moonlight.
config.qsv_preset_desc: Slower presets give better quality at the same bitrate but add encoding latency.
config.qsv_coder_desc: Entropy coding for H.264. CABAC gives better quality; CAVLC is easier to decode on old devices.
config.vt_coder_desc: Entropy coding for H.264. CABAC gives better quality; CAVLC is easier to decode on old devices.
config.vt_software_desc: Whether VideoToolbox may use software encoding when hardware encoding isn't available.
config.vt_realtime_desc: Ask VideoToolbox for real-time encoding, which keeps latency low. Turning it off can improve quality but adds latency.
config.dd_configuration_option_ensure_primary: Turn it on and make it the main display
config.dd_configuration_option_ensure_only_disp: Turn it on and turn the other monitors off
config.category_display_desc: Which screen is streamed and what happens to your monitor.
config.category_input_desc: Controllers, keyboard, mouse and touch, for all devices.
config.category_network_desc: Pairing, finding this PC, ports and encryption.
config.category_apps_desc: Commands that run when apps start, devices connect, or a device asks.
config.category_fixes_desc: Only change these to work around a particular problem.
config.category_files_desc: Where the host keeps its files. Changing these can break pairing.
config.category_nv_desc: Only used with an NVIDIA graphics card.
config.category_amd_desc: Only used with an AMD graphics card.
config.category_sw_desc: Only used when the CPU encodes the stream.
config.section_display_monitor_note: Not used while streaming to a virtual display

pin.allow_client_commands_desc: Allow client commands to be executed when connecting to this device.
pin.always_use_virtual_display_desc: Always create a virtual display when connecting from this device.
pin.client_do_cmd_desc: Commands to be executed when client connects. All of the commands are executed detached.
pin.client_undo_cmd_desc: Commands to be executed when client disconnects. All of the commands are executed detached.
pin.display_mode_override_desc: Norishine will ignore client requested display mode and use this value to configure (virtual) displays. Leave blank for auto matching. Format: [Width]x[Height]x[FPS]
pin.enable_legacy_ordering_desc: Enable app ordering for legacy clients. Disable if this client can't handle UTF8 correctly. Needs to enable "App ordering for legacy clients" in the Advanced settings.
pin.cancel_failure: The pairing request could not be cancelled
pin.load_failure: Pending pairing requests could not be loaded
pin.no_pending_pairings: No devices are waiting to pair
pin.select_pairing_required: Select the device you want to pair
pin.pair_failure: Pairing Failed: Check if the PIN is typed correctly
pin.pair_success: Success! Please check Moonlight to continue
pin.pair_success_check_perm: Pair success! Please grant necessary permissions to the client manually below.
pin.warning_msg: Make sure you have access to the client you are pairing with. This software can give total control to your computer, so be careful!
pin.otp_expired_msg: OTP expired. Please request a new one.
pin.otp_success: PIN request success, the PIN is available within 3 minutes.
pin.otp_msg: OTP pairing is only available for the latest Artemis clients. Please use legacy pairing method for other clients.
pin.otp_pair_now: PIN generated successfully, do you want to pair now?
pin.device_management_desc: Manage your paired devices and their permissions.
pin.device_management_warning: The first paired device can launch apps and send input. Other newly paired devices can only list and view apps. Clipboard access and server commands are never granted automatically.
pin.unpair_single_success: However, the device(s) may still be in an active session. Use the 'Force Close' button above to end any open sessions.

settings.title: Settings
settings.saved_restart: Saved. Restart Norishine to apply the changes.
settings.restarting: Restarting Norishine. Streams on this host stop for a moment.
settings.restarted: Norishine has restarted with the new settings.
settings.restart_timeout: Norishine hasn't come back yet. Check that it is running, then reload this page.
settings.not_saved: Nothing was saved. Fix these settings and try again:
settings.confirm_body: These settings can make the host unreachable or less secure:
settings.depends: Only has an effect when “{setting}” is set to {value}.
settings.stored_invalid: The config file has "{value}" here, which isn't valid ({error}). Norishine uses the default until you save a new value.
settings.unknown_title: Other entries in the config file
settings.unknown_desc: Norishine doesn't use these entries. They are left as they are.
settings.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
settings.key_hint: Windows virtual-key codes, for example 0x10 for Shift.
settings.key_invalid: Use a number from 0 to 65535, like 0xA0 or 160.
settings.more_categories: Turn on advanced settings to see {n} more category. | Turn on advanced settings to see {n} more categories.
settings.result_count: No settings found | 1 setting found | {n} settings found
settings.restart_streams: Restarting ends the stream that is running now. You can also save now and restart later. | Restarting ends the {n} streams that are running now. You can also save now and restart later.
settings.other_encoders: Show the other encoder ({n}) | Show the other encoders ({n})
settings.takes_effect_after_restart: takes effect after the host restarts
settings.only_advanced: Everything here is an advanced setting; most people never need to change these.

account.title: Sign in to Norishine
account.welcome_text: Create the account you'll use to manage this host from a browser. Keep the password safe: it can't be shown again, only reset on this PC.
account.locked: Too many failed sign-ins. Wait a moment and try again.
account.change_intro: Change the username and password for this web interface. Everyone signed in is signed out afterwards.
account.new_username_placeholder: Leave empty to keep the current one
account.changed: Changed. Sign in again with the new password.
account.wrong_current: The current username or password is wrong.
account.forgot: Forgot the password? On this PC, run "norishine --creds <username> <password>" in a Command Prompt opened as administrator, then restart Norishine.

home.startup_errors: Norishine reported these errors when it started. Fix them before streaming:
home.update_body: Streams end while the host restarts. It comes back on its own.
home.no_app_sub: Start one from a client or from Apps.
home.close_body: Streams of this app end, and unsaved work in it may be lost.
home.disconnect_body: The stream to this device ends. The app keeps running.
home.pair_sub: Connect a new client with a PIN.
home.devices_sub: Permissions and names of paired devices.
home.apps_sub: What clients can start on this PC.
home.settings_sub: Display, video, audio, input and network.
home.client_norilight: Made for Norishine: manages this host's settings too.
home.client_artemis: Supports one-time PIN pairing and virtual displays.
home.client_moonlight: Works with Norishine like with any GameStream host.

trouble.title: Troubleshooting
trouble.intro: Fix a stuck stream or app, and read what Norishine logged.
trouble.force_close_desc: Use this when a client says an app is still running. Streams of it end.
trouble.restart_desc: Streams on this host stop while it restarts.
trouble.dd_reset_desc: Use this if Norishine keeps trying to put back display settings it changed for a stream. Your displays are not changed now; set them in Windows yourself if needed.
trouble.dd_reset_confirm: Forget the display changes Norishine wants to undo?
trouble.dd_reset_done: Norishine no longer tries to restore the display settings.
trouble.quit_desc: Stops the host. Start it again from the Start menu, or restart the Norishine service.
trouble.older_hidden: {n} older lines are hidden. Search or download the log to see them.

pairing.title: Pair a device
pairing.intro: Pairing lets a client stream from this PC. Afterwards, choose what it may do on the Devices page.
pairing.pin_steps: Start pairing on the device; it shows up here.
pairing.waiting_help: This page checks every few seconds; the device shows up here once it asks.
pairing.choose_device: Choose the device you are pairing
pairing.cancelled: The pairing request was turned down.
pairing.cancel_failed: Couldn't turn down the pairing request.
pairing.name: Device name
pairing.name_placeholder: Optional, for example Living room TV
pairing.paired: Paired. The client can now see this PC; set its permissions next.
pairing.pin_wrong: Pairing failed. Check the PIN and try again.
pairing.otp_steps: For Artemis: pick a passphrase, then enter the PIN and passphrase on the client (or scan the code with it).
pairing.expired_help: Make a new PIN to pair.
pairing.edit_address: Change the address in the code
pairing.otp_clients: Only Artemis supports this. Moonlight and Norilight pair with a PIN from the client.
pairing.warning: Only pair devices you control: a paired device can get full control of this PC if you allow it.

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: Devices paired with this host, and what each may do.
devices.unpair_all_body: All clients must pair again before they can stream. Running streams continue until they end.
devices.unpair_body: It must pair again before it can stream. A running stream continues until it ends; disconnect it first to stop it now.
devices.name: Name
devices.not_found: the device is no longer paired
devices.clipboard_set_help: Paste from the device into this PC.
devices.clipboard_read_help: Copy from this PC to the device.
devices.server_cmd_help: Run the commands listed under Settings › Apps and commands.
devices.manage_help: For Norilight: lets the device see or manage this host without the web UI password.
devices.manage_none_help: No access to settings, apps or devices.
devices.manage_read_help: Sees status, settings, apps, paired devices and displays.
devices.manage_write_help: Changes settings, apps and paired devices, ends streams and restarts the host. App and device commands run on this PC, so only choose this for devices you trust like this account.
devices.display_mode_help: Use this mode instead of what the device asks for, as width x height x refresh rate. Leave empty to use the device's.
devices.display_mode_invalid: Use width x height x refresh rate, for example 1920x1080x60.
devices.legacy_ordering_help: Sort the app list for older clients. Turn off if this device shows app names wrongly.
devices.allow_commands_help: Runs the commands below, and apps' client commands, when this device connects and disconnects.
devices.first_device_note: The first device you pair may start apps and send input. Devices paired later may only see apps until you allow more here.
devices.quick_help: Pick one, or fine-tune it below.
devices.quick_custom: Custom: the settings below don't match one of these.
devices.preset_watch_help: Joins streams others started. No input.
devices.preset_play_help: Starts apps. Controller and touch input.
devices.preset_full_help: Starts apps. All input and the clipboard.

apps2.title: Apps
apps2.intro: What clients can start on this PC. Clients see changes the next time they refresh their app list.
apps2.order_help: Drag apps by the handle, or use the ⋯ menu, to change the order clients show.
apps2.order_changed: The order changed. Saving it closes the running app.
apps2.refresh_note: Apps are read again when a stream ends.
apps2.cmd_help: The program to start. Leave empty to stream the desktop. Put quotes around a path with spaces.
apps2.dir_output_help: Working directory: the folder the program starts in. Output log file: where to write the program's output (optional).
apps2.image_help: A PNG file on this PC, shown as the app's picture. Find a cover to download one.
apps2.no_covers: No covers found for this name.
apps2.use_global_prep: Run the general commands before and after
apps2.use_global_state: Run the general resume and pause commands
apps2.prep_help: Run before the app starts (start) and after it ends (end). If one fails, the app doesn't start.
apps2.state_help: Run when the first device connects (start) and when the last one disconnects (end).
apps2.detached_help: Started in the background with the app, and left running.
apps2.env_help: Commands and the app get these environment variables:
apps2.delete_body: Clients can no longer start it. This doesn't remove anything from the PC.
apps2.launch_body: It starts without a stream, as if a client had started it.
apps2.launch_replaces: The app that is running now is closed first.
